corrections.text: The article quotes HashiCorp as saying "machine images received less attention in supply-chain security workflows." The HashiCorp blog post actually states: "Machine images have received less attention than many supply-chain security workflows." The quoted sentence in the article is a paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation; the underlying point (that machine images have gotten comparatively less supply-chain-security attention than application packages and containers) is accurately represented.
